title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: waterproofing
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Concourse and amenities waterproofing
swms.task: Apply the waterproofing membrane to the amenities floors and the concourse plant room floors, with primer and polyurethane membrane.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the primer and polyurethane membrane are kept at the work area: use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear gloves and eye protection.

steps: Join PVC pipe with primer and solvent cement
